lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bolaavahi tiu bolah suaamee kudarat kavan hamaaree ||
lines.translation: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak jas gaaio jo prabh kee at piaaree ||8||1||8||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, sing His Praises; they are so very dear to God. ||8||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: naath narahar deen ba(n)dhav patit paavan dev ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Man-lion Incarnate, Companion to the poor, Divine Purifier of sinners;

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhai traas naas kripaal gun nidh saphal suaamee sev ||1||
lines.translation: O Destroyer of fear and dread, Merciful Lord Master, Treasure of Excellence, fruitful is Your service. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gopaal gur gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Cherisher of the World, Guru-Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੇਸਵ ਤਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran daiaal kesav taar jag bhav si(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord. Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹਰਨ ਮਦ ਮੋਹ ਦਹਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh haran mad moh dahan muraar man makara(n)d ||
lines.translation: O Dispeller of sexual desire and anger, Eliminator of intoxication and attachment, Destroyer of ego, Honey of the mind;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaar dharaneedhar pat raakh paramaana(n)d ||2||
lines.translation: set me free from birth and death, O Sustainer of the earth, and preserve my honor, O Embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalat anik tara(n)g maaiaa gur giaan har rid ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: The many waves of desire for Maya are burnt away, when the Guru's spiritual wisdom is enshrined in the heart, through the Guru's Mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੇਦਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਚਿੰਤ ਮੇਟਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chhed aha(n)budh karunaa mai chi(n)t met purakh ana(n)t ||3||
lines.translation: Destroy my egotism, O Merciful Lord; dispel my anxiety, O Infinite Primal Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪਲ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar samarath pal mahoorat prabh dhiaan sahaj samaadh ||
lines.translation: Remember in meditation the Almighty Lord, every moment and every instant; meditate on God in the celestial peace of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾਚੀਐ ਰਜ ਸਾਧ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal prasa(n)n pooran jaacheeai raj saadh ||4||
lines.translation: O Merciful to the meek, perfectly blissful Lord, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh mithan dura(n)t aasaa baasanaa bikaar ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment is false, desire is filthy, and longing is corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: rakh dharam bharam bidaar man te udhar har nira(n)kaar ||5||
lines.translation: Please, preserve my faith, dispel these doubts from my mind, and save me, O Formless Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਢਿ ਆਢਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਚੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaadh aadh bha(n)daar har nidh hot jinaa na cheer ||
lines.translation: They have become wealthy, loaded with the treasures of the Lord's riches; they were lacking even clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੂੜ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: khal mugadh mooR kataakhy sreedhar bhae gun mat dheer ||6||
lines.translation: The idiotic, foolish and senseless people have become virtuous and patient, receiving the Gracious Glance of the Lord of wealth. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat jagadees jap man dhaar rid parateet ||
lines.translation: Become Jivan-Mukta, liberated while yet alive, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and maintaining faith in Him in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸਹ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jee daiaa maiaa sarabatr ramana(n) param ha(n)sah reet ||7||
lines.translation: Show kindness and mercy to all beings, and realize that the Lord is pervading everywhere; this is the way of life of the enlightened soul, the supreme swan. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: det darasan sravan har jas rasan naam uchaar ||
lines.translation: He grants the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to those who listen to His Praises, and who, with their tongues, chant His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥੫॥੧॥੧॥੨॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g bhagavaan parasan prabh naanak patit udhaar ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||
lines.translation: They are part and parcel, life and limb with the Lord God; O Nanak, they feel the Touch of God, the Savior of sinners. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਸਿਕੰਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਹਿਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਉਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree kee vaar mahalaa 3 sika(n)dar biraahim kee vaar kee dhunee gaaunee ||
lines.translation: Goojaree Ki Vaar, Third Mehl, Sung In The Tune Of The Vaar Of Sikandar & Biraahim:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jagat mamataa muaa jeevan kee bidh naahi ||
lines.translation: This world perishing in attachment and possessiveness; no one knows the way of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਣ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai taa(n) jeevan padavee paahi ||
lines.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, obtains the supreme status of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi sadaa sadaa jan jeevate jo har charanee chit laahi ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Feet, live forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree man vasai guramukh sahaj samaahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Lord abides in the minds of the Gurmukhs, who merge in celestial bliss. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar sahasaa dukh hai aapai sir dha(n)dhai maar ||
lines.translation: Within the self is the pain of doubt; engrossed in worldly affairs, they are killing themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai sute kabahi na jaagahi maaiaa moh piaar ||
lines.translation: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are in love with, and attached to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na chetahi sabad na veechaarahi ihu manamukh kaa aachaar ||
lines.translation: They do not think of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad. This is the conduct of the self-willed manmukhs.
